findings.claim: Analyzer diagnostics for members declared only in metadata are deliberately filtered out rather than reported by the consuming compilation. This matches the recorded product convention that the defining assembly owns validation of its types, so it is not a defect.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed by the consuming compilation; their defining assembly owns validation, and missing diagnostics for those types are not defects.
